title: Gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Bag body -->
  <rect x="20" y="35" width="60" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e8436b"/>
  <!-- Bag body lighter highlight -->
  <rect x="23" y="38" width="54" height="44" rx="2" fill="#f06a8a"/>
  <!-- Left side shade -->
  <rect x="20" y="35" width="12" height="50" rx="4" fill="#c93058"/>
  <rect x="20" y="39" width="12" height="42" rx="2" fill="#d43e63"/>
  <!-- Top fold / rim -->
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="64" height="10" rx="3" fill="#c93058"/>
  <rect x="20" y="31" width="60" height="7" rx="2" fill="#e8436b"/>
  <!-- Handles -->
  <path d="M32 30 Q32 12 50 12 Q68 12 68 30" fill="none" stroke="#ffb830" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 30 Q32 15 50 15 Q68 15 68 30" fill="none" stroke="#ffd25e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Polka dots on bag -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="45" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="65" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="70" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="66" r="3.5" fill="#ffd25e"/>
  <!-- Bow on handle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="14" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#ffb830"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="12" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ffd25e" transform="rotate(-25 43 12)"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="12" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ffd25e" transform="rotate(25 57 12)"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="14" r="2.5" fill="#ff8f2a"/>
  <!-- Bottom shadow line -->
  <rect x="20" y="82" width="60" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#b02448"/>
</svg>
